Causes of Abdominal Pain

Overview

This chart organizes possible causes of abdominal pain by the nine anatomical regions of the abdomen. The labels and causes below follow the uploaded chart.

Select a region in the interactive diagram to jump to its list. On phones, the chart opens with the central Umbilical region in view; swipe horizontally to explore the remaining regions.

Interactive abdominal regions chart

Tap any region to read its listed causes. Swipe left or right to view the full chart.
